description: Source code for FreeType's small bitmap cache node management, including functions for loading, copying, freeing, and comparing cache nodes related to small glyph bitmaps.

methods.name: ftc_sbit_copy_bitmap
methods.description: Copies a bitmap into a small cache bit structure buffer, allocating memory as needed.

methods.name: ftc_snode_free
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a small bitmap cache node.

methods.name: FTC_SNode_Free
methods.description: Wrapper to free a small bitmap cache node.

methods.name: ftc_snode_load
methods.description: Loads a small glyph bitmap into a cache node, handling errors and marking unavailable glyphs.

methods.name: FTC_SNode_New
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new small bitmap cache node for a given glyph index.

methods.name: ftc_snode_new
methods.description: Wrapper to create a new small bitmap cache node.

methods.name: ftc_snode_weight
methods.description: Calculates the memory weight of a cache node based on its glyph bitmaps.

methods.name: ftc_snode_compare
methods.description: Compares a cache node with a glyph query, loading glyphs on demand if needed, with retry logic for out-of-memory conditions.
